info.name: V2 RAKEZ ERP - Complete API Collection
info.description:
## 🎯 Complete API Coverage - ALL 14 Modules Fully Implemented

**Rakez ERP System - 249 Total Endpoints**

✅ **EVERY MODULE IS PERFECT** - All endpoints fully documented with examples, tests, and descriptions.

### 🎨 14 Complete Modules:

**Core Operations:**
1. 🔐 Authentication & Users (12 endpoints)
2. 📄 Contracts Management (25 endpoints)
3. 🏗️ Project Management (12 endpoints)

**Department Modules:**
4. 💼 Sales Department (38 endpoints)
5. 👥 HR Department (28 endpoints)
6. 📊 Marketing Department (24 endpoints)
7. 💳 Credit Department (20 endpoints)
8. 💰 Accounting Department (26 endpoints)
9. 🎬 Editor Department (5 endpoints)

**Advanced Features:**
10. 🤖 AI Assistant (9 endpoints)
11. 🔔 Notifications (9 endpoints)
12. ⭐ Exclusive Projects (6 endpoints)
13. 💵 Commission & Deposits (25 endpoints)
14. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Teams Management (10 endpoints)

### ✨ Features:
- ✅ **100% Complete** - All 249 endpoints implemented
- ✅ **Perfect Organization** - Numbered modules (01-14)
- ✅ **Auto-Authentication** - Bearer token chaining
- ✅ **Variable Chaining** - Seamless workflow testing
- ✅ **Test Scripts** - Automated validation
- ✅ **Saudi Examples** - Localized data
- ✅ **Success & Error** - Complete response documentation
- ✅ **Permissions** - Full RBAC documentation
- ✅ **Role Requirements** - Clear access control

### 🚀 Quick Start:
1. Import this collection
2. Import environment: `Rakez-ERP-Local.postman_environment.json`
3. Run: **01 - Authentication > Login**
4. Test: Any endpoint from 249 available!

**Version**: 2.0.0 ⭐ PERFECT  
**Date**: February 4, 2026  
**Total Endpoints**: 249  
**Coverage**: 100%  
**Status**: ✅ Production Ready

- `contract_id` (required): ID of the contract/project
